location.source_text: Place of occurrence: 27157 James Haven, Floresshire

description.value:
Vehicle WKL-0523 was struck on the front nearside by a second vehicle emerging from a side road onto
James Haven. Minor damage to both vehicles, no injuries. Road was dry.
